fact: ANSD closed a four-day regional workshop at Louga on 24 June 2026 on operationalising its Open Data Platform (ODP) 2.0, training about thirty regional staff to create and publish datasets on it as the platform is extended to the regions.

Senegal launched its national Géoportail (Géo Sénégal), giving the public official base and thematic geospatial data, with consultation and download services for institutions' maps; the article carries no date, so the site's news date is used.

The Géoportail carries data from at least two public bodies, the Centre de suivi écologique (bushfire areas 2023) and ANSD (school locations 2023); the article carries no date, so the site's news date is used.
